title: SEO와 GEO 운영 루틴
content: SEO/GEO는 발행으로 끝나지 않는다. 글을 올리고 색인되고 몇 주가 지나면 그때부터 운영이 시작된다. 어떤 글은 검색 결과에 보이지만 클릭되지 않는다. 어떤 글은 클릭은 오지만 전환이 없다. 어떤 글은 10위 근처에서 오래 멈춘다. 어떤 글은 예전에는 잘 됐지만 지금은 정보가 낡았다. 그리고 이제는 하나가 더 붙는다. 검색 결과에는 보이는데 AI 답변에는 전혀 언급되지 않을 수 있다. 그래서 운영 루틴은 검색 성과와 AI 답변 노출을 함께 본다. 검색 성과: 노출, 클릭, CTR, 순위, 전환, 색인 AI 답변 노출: 브랜드 언급, 인용 URL, 설명 정확도, 경쟁 브랜드, 수정 필요 항목 SEO가 검색 결과에서 발견되는 상태를 관리한다면, GEO는 AI 답변 안에서 브랜드와 콘텐츠가 어떻게 쓰이는지 확인하는 작업까지 포함한다. 새 글보다 기존 글이 먼저일 때가 많다 SEO를 시작하면 대부분 새 글을 더 쓰려고 한다. 하지만 실무에서는 기존 글 리라이트가 더 빠르게 성과를 만들 때가 많다. 이유는 단순하다. 이미…

title: 서비스 아이디어 발굴부터 프로토타입까지, AI와 함께 일해본 기록

AI 기반 프로토타이핑 툴을 활용해 아이디어를 빠르게 화면으로 구체화하기 이번 편에서는 그중 첫 번째인 AI Persona를 아이디어 발굴과 고도화 과정에서 어떻게 활용했는지를 이야기해보려고 합니다. Figma Make를 활용해 프로토타입을 제작했던 경험은 2편에서 이어서 다뤄보겠습니다. 사용자 조사 없이 아이디어를 만들다가 부딪힌 장벽 보통 신규 서비스 아이디어를 만드는 프로젝트에서는 사용자 조사를 통해 사용자의 삶의 방식과 페인포인트, 니즈를 파악하고 이를 기반으로 아이데이션을 진행합니다. 이번 프로젝트에서도 데스크 리서치를 통해 기존 서비스에 대…

title: ‘Foodie’ culture is exclusionary – these creative cookbooks are offering an alternative
content: For Disabled people and those living with chronic illness, cooking can be a tricky and arduous task, but this is something often ignored in mainstream foodie culture – typically led by trends, fads and style over substance. Here, Kieran Yates spotlights the cookbooks challenging this fact, and argues creatives have the power to change the way we think (and eat).

title: Logos and glyphs grow out of agar and grapevines in Emi Takahashi’s graphic explorations of living forms
content: The more-than-human world comes alive in the designers visual translations of natures hidden patterns.

title: Templo’s visual identity for DeafCity Hub is a fusion of creative coding, British sign language and gestural motion capture
content: Aiming to move beyond the spoken word, Templo teams up with DeafCity Hub to create purpose-driven campaign visuals that centre and celebrate Deaf culture.

title: Gary Grimes examines the niche memes and noughties tech-optimism behind Zara Larsson’s visual world
content: She dominated summer 2026, appearing on stage at nearly 30 festivals across the world, but Zara Larsson’s fame flourished from behind the screen. It’s Nice That’s culture columnist looks at how an audience raised on a much more carefree internet have helped catapult the singer to stardom.

title: “I like to draw pretty things”: Lia Sued C. on trading too much screen-time for tactile illustrations
content: We touch base with the brilliant illustrator Lia Sued C. on how she moved away from a solely digital practice to refining her skills through physical materials.

title: “This is just another phase the creative industry will take in its stride”
content: The discourse surrounding AI feel relentless due to its rate of progress; what’s new-fangled one week is out of date the next. This is particularly worrying when you feel like your career is getting caught in the crossfire. How can you continue to invest in your career when you don’t know what shape it might take? Sharing her two cents is Katie Cadwell, co-founder of branding studio Lucky Dip and The NDA Podcast, in this week’s Creative Career Conundrums.

title: Oro is a water brand redefining hydration, engineered inside and out — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Oro is a mineral water bottled in Jordan by Oro Labs®, drawn from a desert aquifer around 400 metres down. It runs through a 17-stage filtration process that rebuilds it to a fixed specification so that every bottle is exactly the same. Paris and Ljubljana-based creative collective .raw took on the social, imagery and film, building on the strategy, naming, identity, packaging and digital that was created by London-based studio Two Times Elliott. “Extreme industrial complexity on the inside; complete minimalism on…

title: Jean-Michel Mercier’s identity for Berto reworks the osteria’s codes — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Berto is the first restaurant from chef Riccardo Bertolino and sommelier Isabel Bordeleau, who settled on Montreal’s Villeray area for its neighbourhood life and closeness to Jean-Talon Market. It is an osteria, the warm, convivial and generous kind of Italian neighbourhood restaurant – the cooking is traditional with a contemporary approach. Montreal-based freelance designer and art director Jean-Michel Mercier was commissioned to create the identity and its applications, from the custom wordmark, typographic sys…

title: REUNION creates the name and the identity for skincare brand Tome — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Tome Skincare is built on nearly a decade of research into Spongilla lacustris, a freshwater river sponge that has been used on skin for centuries. Dermata Therapeutics, Tome’s parent company, used the findings to develop the Foundational Treatment – the brand’s first product – a mask used once a week at home. Its hero ingredient is the sponge in powder form, which Tome calls Bioneedle. The product is on sale direct to consumers, while Tome is also building a channel for aestheticians and other skincare profession…

title: AUGE Design sets pear brand Eden Gold’s identity in a Garden of Eden — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Greenyard Fresh Italy handles the import, export and wholesale distribution of fresh fruit and vegetables as the Italian arm of the Belgian group Greenyard. Eden Gold is a new pear variety, for which the company decided to build a brand to bring it to market.

title: Hochburg designs the identity for PARK, the renamed Stuttgart club — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Perkins Park has been part of Stuttgart’s nightlife since 1980. In 2026, it took a new name, PARK, along with a programme led by house and techno, more international bookings and a club reconfigured for larger-scale nights and a new audience. Local design studio Hochburg, in a long-standing collaboration with club operator Denis Gugac, was commissioned to create the new identity.

title: Mexico meets Japan across AH Work’s colourful identity for Salsa Mutua — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Salsa Mutua is a Mexican brand of ‘crispy chilli oil made with salsa and chilli crisp. “We had an initial idea of a name for the sauce: ‘Rayito.’ But we quickly learned that this name was going to be impossible to register as a trademark,” Founders Sebastian and Alejandro tell us. The name they landed on instead comes from the Spanish ‘mutuo,’ meaning something reciprocal between two parts, or something balanced. “It can also be something like a shared experience, like sharing a meal,” they note. “Sebastian’s brot…

title: ‘Visual Joy’ guides Bathgate Design’s identity for artist Alex Fulton — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: For 12 years, New Zealand artist and interior designer Alex Fulton presented herself through the same identity. “Eventually you realise you’ve moved and the furniture hasn’t,” Fulton tells us. Her practice runs across interiors, teaching, speaking and the original pieces that she sells through galleries, while the art has increasingly become a much bigger part of what she does. She asked Bathgate Design for a new identity that could represent all of that rather than a tidy-up of the one she already had. The Christ…

title: NEW STANDARD.S gives climate journalism critic Brandmelder an identity — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Brandmelder observes climate reporting in German media and puts it in context, pointing out the patterns that keep recurring. It is an editorial project of Netzwerk Klimajournalismus Deutschland e.V., a network that brings climate knowledge into newsrooms. Berlin-based sustainability consultancy and creative studio NEW STANDARD.S was commissioned to create the brand strategy, identity and website in a month, with social media assets, merchandise and a custom image tool alongside.

title: Studio Tyrrell positions chocolate maker Manta around its ingredients — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Manta is a British bean-to-bar chocolate maker whose cacao is Fino de Aroma, grown on an organic farm in Madagascar and fermented but never roasted, to keep the beans’ raw benefits. It never uses dairy, refined sugar or chemical additives, so its sweetness comes from Jerusalem artichoke syrup, dehydrated juices, freeze-dried fruits and berries, and coconut palm flower nectar. Studio Tyrrell was brought on board to create the brand strategy, identity, creative direction, packaging and digital design.

title: Socio take cues from fashion and luxury in their radiant identity for supplement brand Natural Glow — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: From British healthcare brand Wild Nutrition, Natural Glow is a supplement that boosts the body’s melanin, collagen and keratin production levels. Aiming to make a splash in suncare, Natural Glow turned to London-based creative agency Socio, who have developed a calm, typographically-led identity and packaging system.

title: Unleashing Monstie: Verve transforms Inbox Monster’s mascot into a hairy, horned brand hero — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Pressing send on an email campaign destined for thousands of inboxes creates what Amsterdam-based agency Verve calls ‘the sending scaries’ – that sweat-inducing moment of stress every email marketer knows. For North Carolina-based email marketing platform Inbox Monster, this anxiety became the foundation for a complete mascot-led rebrand that transforms their existing green character into an unforgettable brand universe.

title: Moniker combine function and flair in their lively identity refresh for crypto platform Coinbase — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Digital cryptocurrency platform Coinbase, established to create the most accessible online crypto economy, found itself caught between two contexts – leading the wave of new economic conventions while seeking to inhabit the same space as traditional banking. In need of an identity refresh to best traverse this landscape, Coinbase turned to San Francisco-based design studio Moniker – looking for a system that brings the digital financial future together with the trust and security of tradition.
